payload.text: If I ___ the alarm, I wouldn't have missed the train. (hear)
payload.explanation_uz: Uchinchi turdagi shart gapda (o'tgan zamondagi o'xshatilmagan holat) if-qismida Past Perfect ishlatiladi: had heard.

payload.text: If he ___ so much last night, he wouldn't be so tired now. (not / drink)
payload.explanation_uz: Aralash shart gap: o'tgan sabab (Past Perfect) va hozirgi natija (would + infinitiv); if-qismida had not drunk kerak.

payload.text: Had I known about the delay, I ___ earlier. (leave)
payload.explanation_uz: Inversiyali uchinchi shart gap (Had I known = If I had known); asosiy qismda would have + V3 ishlatiladi.

payload.text: Supposing you ___ the lottery tomorrow, what would you do? (win)
payload.explanation_uz: 'Supposing' = 'if'; xayoliy (ikkinchi tur) shartda shart qismida Past Simple ishlatiladi: won.

payload.text: I'd rather you ___ in here. (not / smoke)
payload.explanation_uz: 'would rather + shaxs' konstruksiyasidan keyin hozirgi/kelasi zamonga nisbatan Past Simple ishlatiladi: didn't smoke.

payload.text: The contract ought ___ by both parties before Friday. (sign)
payload.explanation_uz: Modal fe'l (ought to) majhul nisbatda: ought to + be + V3 (to be signed).

payload.text: He asked me whether I ___ the report the day before. (finish)
payload.explanation_uz: Egri nutqda o'tgan zamon (Past Simple/Present Perfect) Past Perfect'ga o'tadi: had finished.

payload.text: The car needs ___ before the long journey. (service)
payload.explanation_uz: 'need' + -ing yoki to be + V3 majhul ma'noda ishlatiladi: needs servicing = needs to be serviced.

payload.text: By this time next year, the new bridge ___. (complete)
payload.explanation_uz: Kelasi zamonning aniq nuqtasigacha tugaydigan majhul harakat — Future Perfect Passive: will have been completed.

payload.text: When we were children, we ___ spend every summer at our grandparents' village.
payload.explanation_uz: O'tgan zamondagi odatiy harakat: would yoki used to + infinitiv.

payload.text: I was just about ___ the house when the phone rang. (leave)
payload.explanation_uz: 'be about to + infinitiv' = ayni harakatni boshlash arafasida bo'lish: was about to leave.

payload.text: The suspect is believed ___ the country last night. (leave)
payload.explanation_uz: Majhul tuzilma 'is believed + to have + V3' o'tgan voqeani bildiradi.

payload.text: I wish I ___ more time to prepare yesterday. (have)
payload.explanation_uz: O'tgan zamondagi afsus uchun wish + Past Perfect ishlatiladi: had had.

payload.text: If only I ___ how to fix this, but I have no idea. (know)
payload.explanation_uz: Hozirgi afsusni bildiruvchi 'if only' dan keyin Past Simple ishlatiladi: knew.

payload.text: She has two brothers, both of ___ are doctors.
payload.explanation_uz: Predlogdan keyin (both of) shaxs uchun non-defining relative clause'da 'whom' ishlatiladi.

payload.text: The house ___ roof was damaged in the storm has been repaired.
payload.explanation_uz: Egalikni bildiruvchi relative olmosh: whose + ot.

payload.text: She admitted ___ the vase. (break)
payload.explanation_uz: 'admit' fe'lidan keyin gerund (-ing) ishlatiladi; o'tgan voqea uchun having broken ham mumkin.

payload.text: I regret ___ you that the flight has been cancelled. (tell)
payload.explanation_uz: 'regret to + infinitiv' = achinib xabar qilish (hozirgi harakat); 'regret + -ing' = o'tgan ishdan afsuslanish.

payload.text: I remember ___ the door, so it can't be my fault. (lock)
payload.explanation_uz: 'remember + -ing' = o'tgan ishni eslash; 'remember to + inf' = bajarishni unutmaslik.

payload.text: He looked shocked, so he must ___ the news yesterday. (hear)
payload.explanation_uz: O'tgan zamonga oid taxmin (deduction): must + have + V3.

payload.text: By next June, they ___ married for twenty years. (be)
payload.explanation_uz: Aniq muddat bilan kelasi zamonda tugallanadigan holat — Future Perfect: will have been.

payload.text: This time tomorrow I ___ on a beach. (lie)
payload.explanation_uz: Kelasi zamonning aniq vaqtida davom etayotgan harakat — Future Continuous: will be lying.

payload.text: ___ had she entered the room than the phone rang.
payload.explanation_uz: Inversiya: 'No sooner + had + ega ... than' — 'tezda, shu zahoti' ma'nosida.

payload.text: Not only ___ he late, but he also forgot the documents.
payload.explanation_uz: Salbiy/cheklovchi ibora gap boshida kelganda inversiya bo'ladi: Not only was he ...

payload.text: Prices rose sharply. ___, demand did not fall.
payload.explanation_uz: Qarama-qarshilikni bildiruvchi bog'lovchi so'zlar: however, nevertheless, nonetheless, even so va h.k.

payload.question: If I had studied medicine, I ___ a doctor now.
payload.explanation_uz: Aralash shart gap: o'tgan shart (had studied) va hozirgi natija (would + infinitiv).

payload.question: The ___ he practised, the better he played.
payload.explanation_uz: Qiyosiy bog'lanish 'the + comparative ..., the + comparative': the more ..., the better.

payload.question: We were made ___ our shoes at the door.
payload.explanation_uz: 'make' majhul nisbatda to bilan infinitiv talab qiladi: were made to take off.

payload.question: I can't help ___ that he is lying.
payload.explanation_uz: 'can't help' dan keyin gerund (-ing) keladi: can't help thinking.

payload.question: The report, ___ I read yesterday, was very detailed.
payload.explanation_uz: Vergul bilan ajratilgan non-defining clause'da 'that' ishlatilmaydi; narsa uchun 'which'.

payload.question: He insisted ___ paying for dinner.
payload.explanation_uz: 'insist on + gerund' birikmasi: insisted on paying.

payload.question: You ___ me earlier; I would have helped.
payload.explanation_uz: O'tgan zamondagi tanqid/maslahat: should have + V3.

payload.question: The lights are on, so they ___ at home.
payload.explanation_uz: Hozirgi zamonda kuchli ishonch bilan taxmin: must + infinitiv.

payload.question: Rarely ___ such a beautiful sunset.
payload.explanation_uz: Rarely kabi cheklovchi ravish gap boshida kelsa inversiya bo'ladi: have I seen.

payload.question: She spoke so quietly that I could ___ hear her.
payload.explanation_uz: 'hardly' = deyarli ... emas (inkor ma'noli ravish); 'hard' boshqa ma'no beradi.

payload.question: It's no use ___ over spilt milk.
payload.explanation_uz: 'It's no use' dan keyin gerund keladi: crying.

payload.question: The number of students applying ___ risen steadily.
payload.explanation_uz: 'The number of' birlikdagi ega: fe'l ham birlikda — has risen.

payload.question: By the time you arrive, I ___ dinner.
payload.explanation_uz: Kelasi vaqtgacha tugallangan harakat — Future Perfect.

payload.question: He was too proud ___ for help.
payload.explanation_uz: 'too + sifat + to + infinitiv' qurilmasi: too proud to ask.

payload.question: He denied ___ anything about the robbery.
payload.explanation_uz: 'deny' fe'lidan keyin gerund keladi: denied knowing.
